selection.reason: The annotated rear-position, stop and reversing functions fall within R148 and require compliance of the assembled lamp with the applicable optical, colour, performance and marking requirements.
The separate passive retro-reflector is a retro-reflective device covered by R150, with its class and compliance to be established for the intended application.

The electrically powered LED board brings the lamp's electrical/electronic assembly within the applicable electromagnetic-compatibility requirements, subject to R10's subassembly classification provisions.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the host vehicle is category M, N or O, R48 governs the lamp functions' and retro-reflector's positioning, visibility, orientation and applicable electrical connections.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the host vehicle is category L3, R53 is the applicable installation regulation for the covered rear lighting and retro-reflective devices instead of R48.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If fitted to an M1 vehicle, the exposed lens, housing and attachment features must satisfy the applicable external-projection requirements at their installed location.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): R128 applies to the light sources only if the LED implementation uses a standardised source category covered by its Annex 1, rather than merely an integral LED board assessed with the lamp under R148.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): For an M1 vehicle assessed under R42, the rear lamp and its mounting contribute to meeting the requirements for continued operation and visibility of lighting and signalling devices after low-speed impact tests.
Its rear-position and stop-lamp provisions are consolidated into selected UN R148, so it is not selected separately.
Its reversing-lamp provisions are consolidated into selected UN R148, so it is not selected separately.
Its retro-reflector provisions are consolidated into selected UN R150, so it is not selected separately.
Its scope expressly excludes glazing for lighting and light-signalling devices, including this lamp's outer lens.
The specification describes rear signalling and reversing functions, not the headlamps, front fog lamps, cornering lamps or adaptive front-lighting systems covered by R149.

drawing.product: Exploded view of a vehicle rear combination lamp with an LED light-source board, reflector optics, and a separate retro-reflector.
drawing.vehicle_location: Rear exterior of the vehicle; exact mounting position and left- or right-hand side are not shown.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Covers and protects the lamp optics while transmitting emitted and retro-reflected light.
parts.technology: Light-transmitting lens, likely molded plastic; labeled red.
parts.evidence: Frontmost elongated, rounded panel with a peripheral rim, transparency strokes, and a small outlined rectangular region.

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Returns incident external light toward its source without requiring electrical illumination.
parts.technology: Passive retro-reflective optical insert; precise prism structure and material are not resolved.
parts.evidence: Separate small rectangular plate with parallel internal lines, labeled 'Retro-reflector,' aligned with the rectangular region in the outer lens.

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals the interface between the outer lens and the lamp body against water ingress.
parts.technology: Continuous perimeter sealing element, likely elastomeric.
parts.evidence: Thin, open-center outline matching the lamp perimeter, positioned behind the outer lens and labeled 'Seal / gasket.'

parts.name: Reflector
parts.function: Collects and redirects source light into the lamp's output pattern.
parts.technology: Multi-cell optical reflector; substrate and reflective coating are unspecified.
parts.evidence: Contoured intermediate panel containing rows of oval optical cells, an upper row of smaller circular features, a narrow upper channel, and separate rectangular regions.

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.technology: LED array mounted on a printed circuit board.
parts.evidence: Separate elongated board behind the reflector with repeated rows of small square packages, additional rectangular component or contact features, and a larger outlined feature at one end.

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Supports and encloses the optical and electronic components and provides attachment locations.
parts.technology: Tray-like housing, likely molded plastic; material is not specified.
parts.evidence: Rearmost shell has a recessed interior, raised perimeter flange, visible depth, and three circular attachment features.

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Secure the assembly or attach it to supporting structure.
parts.technology: Three screw-like mechanical fasteners; material and exact fastening type are unspecified.
parts.evidence: Three detached headed shanks are drawn near dashed assembly lines beside and below the housing.

uncertainties: The vehicle body interface, exact mounting position, and handedness are not shown.

The annotation performance statements cannot be verified from the drawing alone.
